title: Deliver Jaw-Dropping Moments
heading: Part II. Novel
keyClaims: Chapter 5 argues that a talk becomes more memorable when it contains one or more jaw-dropping moments built from surprise, demonstration, or emotional lift.
Bill Gates, Jill Bolte Taylor, and Steve Jobs are used as chapter anchors for unexpected demos, vivid props, and staged reveals that make the message stick.
Wow moments work best when they clarify the point, use practical creative tools, and end on a high note rather than collapsing into empty showmanship.

usedFor: end on a high note constraint
